requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
2–3 years of professional software engineering experience, including shipping and maintaining production code, ideally on AI/ML-enabled or data-intensive applications.
Solid working knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and software design fundamentals, applied to write clean, testable code.
Working knowledge of core AI/ML concepts: supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, model evaluation, and how models are deployed and served in production.
Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred given its centrality to the ML ecosystem) or another backend language, with experience building and maintaining APIs and services.
Hands-on professional experience with web development (React, Angular, or comparable framework) building user-facing features.
Working experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases, including schema design and query optimization.
A problem-solving mindset and genuine curiosity about how AI can change the way software works.
Must be able to demonstrate lawful ability to work in the United States
All iTradeNetwork positions are hybrid unless listed otherwise; candidates must be located in the hub(s) listed.
Hands-on experience with Python ML libraries: TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and deploying ML workloads in the cloud.
Experience integrating LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns into applications.
Working knowledge of MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, model registries, CI/CD for ML pipelines.
Experience taking an AI/ML application from prototype to production, whether in a professional setting or through significant project work.
